apiAccess.title: API Access
apiAccess.description: Integrate this Agent into your applications via API
apiAccess.draftWarningDescription: Draft status only affects publishing and discovery. API requests still require a caller with Agent access and a valid Bearer JWT or API key.
apiAccess.endpointDescription: Send messages using POST requests and receive streaming responses.
apiAccess.authDescription: Authenticate with a Bearer JWT or API key. A scoped API key must include this Agent.

params.conversationId: Conversation ID for multi-turn dialogue. Leave empty (null) for the first message; message_start returns conversation_id for later requests.
params.images: ImageContent objects. Each requires url; asset_id selects an authorized Asset and asset_ref reuses a conversation-scoped Asset.
params.fileUrls: FileUrl objects. Each requires filename, url, mime_type, and size; asset_id can reference an authorized uploaded Asset.

apiAccess.sseDescription: Responses are streamed using Server-Sent Events (SSE). Events vary by Agent configuration and model behavior:

events.messageStart: Message started; contains conversation_id, message_id, and user_message_id
events.ragContext: RAG retrieval results with relevant documents
events.reasoningStart: Reasoning started when the model emits reasoning
events.toolCall: Tool call with tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_display_name, and arguments
events.toolResult: Tool result with the matching tool_call_id, result, and is_error
events.mediaResult: Media payload emitted for a media.image or media.video tool result
events.compressionStart: Context compression started before a model call
events.compressionEnd: Context compression finished with token-budget metadata
events.outputTruncated: Output was truncated due to max output token limit
events.iterationCapReached: The round hit the maximum tool-call iterations and ended with a terminal notice
events.messageEnd: Message ended with usage, timing, version_number, and version_count

apiAccess.runLifecycleDescription: Agent chat runs are durable. These run-scoped events carry an envelope with run_id, sequence, timestamp, round_id, message_id and type so reconnects resume via after_sequence without duplicates:

runEvents.runStart: Run started; contains run_id and status
runEvents.runStatus: Run status transition. Enter waiting when the model calls ask_user — the payload carries pending_tool_call_id, pending_tool_name, and pending_tool_input so the client can render the question form

apiAccess.answerDescription: When a run is waiting for user answers, submit structured answers to resume it:

answerFields.toolCallId: Pending tool-call ID from the run_status waiting event
answerFields.answers: ID-keyed answer map; each value is the chosen option or a custom string
answerFields.skipped: Explicitly skip every question (sends an empty answer map)

apiAccess.answerNote: The run must be in waiting status and the tool_call_id must match the pending interaction.
